basic_details.job_title: CURAJ Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) has notified 1 vacancy for the Project Associate I post on a contractual basis, running up to 31 March 2027 with extension possibilities. Eligible candidates holding an M.Sc. or M.Tech. in the specified disciplines can apply for the position. The remuneration is Rs. 37,000 plus HRA for UGC NET category 1 and 2, Rs. 30,000 plus HRA for category 3, and Rs. 25,000 plus HRA for non-NET candidates. how_to_apply: Prepare an application on plain paper containing candidate name, father's name, date of birth, age, category, address of communication, email ID, mobile no., qualifications from 10th onwards, and NET/GATE details along with a detailed CV.
Attach attested copies of degree(s) / certificate(s) and experience certificates including research, industrial and others if any. Combine all relevant documents into a single PDF file only.
Send the application by email to the Principal Investigator of the project at [email protected] with the subject line "Application for Project Associate Position".
Fill in the application details in the official Google form: https://forms.gle/p53dyi4WakQXbVRI9.
Ensure application submission on or before 26th October 2026.

rows.details: Department of Atmospheric Science, School of Earth Sciences
Regional Characterization of Atmospheric Aerosols from selected distinct locations of India
Indian Space Research Organisation - Geosphere Biosphere Programme: Aerosol Radiative Forcing over India (ISRO-GBP: ARFI)
Upto 31 March 2027 with possibility of extension
Rs. 37,000/- + HRA (UGC NET category 1 or 2 or equivalent), Rs. 30000/- + HRA (UGC NET category 3 or equivalent), Rs. 25000/- + HRA for non-NET candidates
Upper age limit: 35 years on the date of the advertisement

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Project Associate I position must meet the essential qualification requirements and age limits specified below.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly fellowship is structured based on candidate qualifications: Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA for candidates with UGC NET qualified category 1 or 2 or equivalent; Rs. 30,000/- plus HRA for UGC NET qualified category 3 or equivalent; and Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA for non-NET candidates. The assignment tenure is up to 31 March 2027 with a possibility of extension based on performance and availability of fund in the project. Selected candidates can also be considered for the Ph.D. program of the university after fulfilling required criteria as per university rules and seat availability in upcoming admission cycles.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CURAJ Project Associate I
content_sections.text: Prepare an application on plain paper containing candidate name, father's name, date of birth, age, category, address of communication, email ID, mobile no., qualifications from 10th onwards, and NET/GATE details along with a detailed CV. Attach attested copies of degree(s) / certificate(s) and experience certificates including research, industrial and others if any. Combine all relevant documents into a single PDF file only. Send the application by email to the Principal Investigator of the project at [email protected] with the subject line "Application for Project Associate Position" . Fill in the application details in the official Google form: https://forms.gle/p53dyi4WakQXbVRI9. Ensure application submission on or before 26th October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be considered for an interview in physical mode only at a later date, which will be intimated by email. Selected candidates must bring all original certificates, experience certificates, and other relevant documents at the time of joining for verification.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Associate-I post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The position is a temporary project-based assignment running up to 31 March 2027 with a possibility of extension based on performance and fund availability.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Yes, House Rent Allowance (HRA) is added to the monthly fellowship depending on whether the candidate qualifies under UGC NET category 1/2, category 3, or is a non-NET candidate.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications mentioned in the notice?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include UGC-NET qualification (category-1, 2, or 3), Maths or Physics studied as a subject at the Bachelors level, experience in data analysis or instrumentation, and working knowledge of any programming language.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be shortlisted for selection?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be considered for an interview in physical mode only at a later date, with intimation sent via email.

faq.question: Q5. What should be written in the subject line of the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must write "Application for Project Associate Position" in the subject line of their email when sending application documents to the Principal Investigator.
